# GeoTapp

> GeoTapp is a work-proof platform for companies with field teams (cleaning, installers, electricians, plumbers, HVAC, security, construction). GPS-verified clock-ins, photo evidence and time logs are sealed into a tamper-evident job report that the end client can verify independently. Built in Italy, EU-hosted data, GDPR-first. 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

Three tools, one cycle: the field records, the office sees, the client verifies. The website is available in 11 languages (IT, EN, DE, FR, ES, PT, NL, DA, SV, NB, RU); the links below point to the English versions, each page links its translations.

## Products

- [GeoTapp TimeTracker](https://geotapp.com/en/products/geotapp-timetracker/): native mobile app for GPS-verified time tracking and proof capture in the field
- [GeoTapp Flow](https://geotapp.com/en/products/geotapp-flow/): web back office with CRM, quotes, team and job management
- [GeoTapp Verifier](https://geotapp.com/en/products/geotapp-verifier/): free independent verification of sealed reports, no account needed
- [What is GeoTapp](https://geotapp.com/en/what-is-geotapp/): plain-language overview of the whole platform

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://geotapp.com/en/pricing/): Flow plans (Solo, Team, Business) billed monthly or annually; TimeTracker licensed per active operator with volume tiers. All prices are published on the page. Every trial includes the full Business feature set for 14 days.
- [ROI calculator](https://geotapp.com/en/roi-calculator/): estimate the hidden cost of paperwork, disputes and verbal coordination
